title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 43
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 43: the remnant calling Jeremiah a liar, the journey to Tahpanhes, and the stones hidden at the entry of Pharaoh's house.

questions.text: Who told Jeremiah, "You speak falsely," when he had finished speaking all the words of Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Azariah the son of Hoshaiah, Johanan the son of Kareah, and all the proud men said to Jeremiah, "You speak falsely."

answers.text: Jezaniah son of Hoshaiah and the priests of Yahweh's house
Azariah son of Hoshaiah, Johanan son of Kareah and the proud men
The king's daughters and the eunuchs of the king's house
Ishmael son of Nethaniah and the ten men with him

questions.text: Whom did they accuse of turning Jeremiah against them?
questions.explanation: They said that Baruch the son of Neriah had turned Jeremiah against them, to deliver them into the hand of the Chaldeans.

answers.text: Gedaliah the son of Ahikam
Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard
Johanan the son of Kareah
Baruch the son of Neriah

questions.text: What did Johanan, the captains and all the people refuse to obey?
questions.explanation: Johanan the son of Kareah, all the captains of the forces and all the people didn't obey Yahweh's voice, to dwell in the land of Judah.

answers.text: Yahweh's voice, to dwell in the land of Judah
The command of the king of Babylon
The oath they had sworn to Gedaliah
The word of Baruch the son of Neriah

questions.text: Who went along when the remnant was taken away, besides the men, women and children?
questions.explanation: They took the men, the women, the children, the king's daughters, and everyone Nebuzaradan had left with Gedaliah, and also Jeremiah the prophet and Baruch the son of Neriah.

answers.text: Only the captains of the forces
The princes of Judah and the priests
The king's daughters, with Jeremiah and Baruch
Ishmael and the men of war

questions.text: To which place in the land of Egypt did they come?
questions.explanation: They came into the land of Egypt, for they didn't obey Yahweh's voice, and they came to Tahpanhes.

answers.text: To Beth Shemesh
To Tahpanhes
To Geruth Chimham
To Mizpah

questions.text: What was Jeremiah told to do with great stones in Tahpanhes?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah was told to take great stones in his hand and hide them in mortar in the brick work at the entry of Pharaoh's house in Tahpanhes, in the sight of the men of Judah.

answers.text: To set them up as a pillar by the river
To throw them into the middle of the pit
To build an altar of them before the people
To hide them in mortar at the entry of Pharaoh's house

questions.text: Whom did Yahweh of Armies say he would send and set his throne on those stones?
questions.explanation: Yahweh of Armies said he would send and take Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon, his servant, and set his throne on these stones.

answers.text: Nebuchadnezzar the king of Babylon
Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard
Pharaoh the king of Egypt
Johanan the son of Kareah

questions.text: What will Nebuchadnezzar do to the land of Egypt when he comes?
questions.explanation: The text says he will come and strike the land of Egypt: such as are for death to death, such as are for captivity to captivity, and such as are for the sword to the sword.

answers.text: He will make a covenant with its princes
He will carry away only its silver and gold
He will strike it with death, captivity and the sword
He will pass through it without touching it

questions.text: How will Nebuchadnezzar array himself with the land of Egypt?
questions.explanation: The text says he will array himself with the land of Egypt as a shepherd puts on his garment, and he will go out from there in peace.

answers.text: As a bridegroom puts on his crown
As a shepherd puts on his garment
As a soldier puts on his armor
As a priest puts on his linen

questions.text: What will Nebuchadnezzar break in the land of Egypt?
questions.explanation: The text says he will break the pillars of Beth Shemesh, that is in the land of Egypt, and will burn the houses of the gods of Egypt with fire.

answers.text: The pillars of Beth Shemesh
The gates of Tahpanhes
The walls of Pharaoh's house
The ships of the river
